key_insight: SolCloudLLM fuses sky images and time-series in both directions to help an LLM better anticipate cloud-driven PV and GHI fluctuations.
engineering_relevance: The method targets more reliable short-term solar forecasting for grid dispatch and reserve planning, especially when local site data are limited.
method: Aligns sky-image patches with time-series patches
Fuses modality representations bidirectionally into a unified embedding
Maps the fused representation into an LLM for forecasting
evidence_signal: Experiments on SIRTA and SKIPP'D show consistent MSE gains across all horizons, with up to 25.4% relative MSE reduction and strongest benefits under cloudy conditions.
watch_item: Performance likely depends on access to quality site-specific sky imagery, so deployment may be constrained at locations without reliable camera data.
paper_title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
